# Ingenuity Systems

Ingenuity Systems is an AI-native technology company with locations in Lahore, Pakistan, and Wyoming, USA. It builds AI agents, chatbots, RAG systems, workflow and business-process automation, systems integration and APIs, and custom software.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://ingenuitysys.com/): Overview of Ingenuity Systems and its AI-native solutions.
- [About](https://ingenuitysys.com/about): Company background, founders, and approach to technology.
- [Services](https://ingenuitysys.com/services): Software engineering, AI, business-process automation, and systems integration.
- [AI & Intelligent Systems](https://ingenuitysys.com/services-ai): AI agents, RAG systems, chatbots, and intelligent systems.
- [Business Process Automation](https://ingenuitysys.com/services-automation): Business-process automation, workflows, and connected operations.
- [Systems Integration & Data](https://ingenuitysys.com/services-integration): Systems, APIs, and data integration.
- [Software & Digital Engineering](https://ingenuitysys.com/services-software): Custom software, applications, digital products, and internal systems.
- [Industries](https://ingenuitysys.com/industries): Technology solutions across the industries served by the company.
- [Ecommerce & Retail](https://ingenuitysys.com/industries-ecommerce): Digital commerce, automation, and intelligent workflows.
- [Financial Services](https://ingenuitysys.com/industries-financial): Process automation and intelligent operations.
